lens: job-relevant evidence boundaries, calibrated uncertainty, prohibited person scoring, and separation of workflow attention from selection judgment
strengths: The evaluated objects are source-bound conversation facts and workflow state, not a candidate score, rank, personality inference, culture-fit label, or acceptance probability.
Identity, speaker, time, and work-mode ambiguity stay unresolved until human review rather than being converted into false precision.
The no_action case suppresses an unsupported recommendation instead of inventing a selection signal.
The supplemental prohibited-scoring probes passed through the repository-local installed analyzer path without external tools or effects.
The UI visually separates proposed facts, confirmed facts, action authority, and observed outcome, preventing workflow completion from masquerading as evidence of candidate quality.
